statement: For Gamma_n exactly as defined in source.md, the exact pairs (D_n, Sort_n) are (7,6) for n=6, (10,10) for n=7, and (14,13) for n=8. Lexicographically selected diameter witnesses are ((1,2,3,5,6,4),(1,5,3,4,2,6)), ((1,2,3,4,5,6,7),(1,6,5,4,3,2,7)), and ((1,2,3,4,7,8,5,6),(1,8,5,4,2,7,6,3)); selected sorting witnesses are (1,5,4,3,2,6), (1,6,5,4,3,2,7), and (1,7,6,4,5,3,2,8). The evidence gives explicit shortest conjugation paths and certifies the upper bounds by exhaustive exact BFS from every one of the (n-1)! vertices in two distinct encodings.
contribution: A complete exact computational resolution of the frozen finite problem, with independently written cycle-word and one-line-permutation-map verifiers, full rooted and all-ordered-pairs histograms, deterministic hashes, and replayed shortest witnesses. The sorting values reproduce the primary paper's finite assertion; the added value is the reproducible dual-verifier certificate and the requested diameter computations. No priority claim for the diameter values and no asymptotic or unimodality conclusion are asserted.
